PROP-kintai-v3-st-inv-014.text: PKCE code_challenge must be verified on token exchange to prevent authorization code interception.
PROP-kintai-v3-st-inv-014.assertion: forall exchange: token_exchange(code) => verify_pkce(code.challenge, req.verifier) == true

locations.note: verifyCodeChallenge called at L109-113 with codeVerifier, authCode.code_challenge, authCode.code_challenge_method; returns 400 if invalid
S256 only: SHA256(verifier) base64url == challenge; method != S256 returns false
